name: Ouarzazate
tagline: Gateway to the Sahara and the kasbah of Aït Benhaddou
summary: Ouarzazate is the "door of the desert" south of the High Atlas, and Morocco's film capital. Explore the fortified earthen village of Aït Benhaddou, seen in countless films, tour the Atlas Film Studios and Taourirt Kasbah, then drive the Road of a Thousand Kasbahs to the Dades and Todra gorges on the way to the Sahara.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn; summers are hot and winter nights cold.
arrival: About 4 hours by road from Marrakech over the Tizi n'Tichka pass; small airport.
cashTip: Carry dirhams; cards work in larger hotels. Tip 10 percent in restaurants and small change to guides.
foodTip: Tagines, Berber omelette and mint tea.

connections.note: Via the Dades and Todra gorges.
